about: The rule «верно в два разных дня» exactly as the database applies it (supabase/migrations/20261009093500_containers.sql: meldy_private.rule_step after meldy_private.grade_answer, the two functions record_test_answers_for calls). Generated by supabase/tests/local/containers_behaviour.sql (containers_run_all.sh); do not edit by hand.
units: at, due_before and every moment of the state are epoch milliseconds (whole seconds); days are local days YYYY-MM-DD; the wire (plan_inputs) sends the same moments as epoch seconds.
rules: Rev: when the event's rev differs from the state's itemRev, the state first starts from zero (seen, right, wrong, checks 0; every day and moment null; wasTwoDays false).
late: lastDay is set and the event's day is before it — the state does not move (the log keeps the answer).

misclick: a wrong answer or a «Не знаю» pressed by mistake that the student marked «Нажали не туда?» — peekDay = day; firstDay ??= day; lastDay = max(lastDay, day); seen, right, wrong, the series and lastResult stay. A misclick flag on a right answer is ignored (the answer is a right answer).
Otherwise a retry counts as a retry only when firstDay is set. A non-retry answer: seen+1, firstDay ??= day, lastDay = max(lastDay, day).
miss: wrong or «Не знаю» (retries included): wrong+1; lastResult = wrong | dont_know; wasTwoDays ||= twoDaysAt != null; seriesAt/Day, twoDaysAt/Day, namedAt = null; checks = 0; peekDay = day.
training: right in a retry, or peekDay = day: a non-retry one adds right+1; nothing else moves (lastResult, cleanOkAt, namedAt stay).

A clean right answer: right+1, lastResult = right, cleanOkAt = at, namedAt = at, then: in the figure (twoDaysAt set) — check (checks+1) when at >= due_before, else early; no series — start (seriesAt = at, seriesDay = day); day != seriesDay and at - seriesAt >= 20 h — two_days (twoDaysAt = at, twoDaysDay = day, checks = 0); else too_early.
due_before = namedAt + 24 h × [5, 12, 25, 50][min(checks, 3)]; when exam_day - day is 0, 1 or 2 days: min(that, namedAt + 96 h). Null when the item is not in the figure.

Grading: single/multiple — the chosen index or set equals the key (file order, any order of the set, all or nothing); null or [] = «Не знаю». short — normalise both sides (lower case; ё → е; every run of whitespace → one space; trim; drop one final «.» and trim again) and compare with each accepted form; null = «Не знаю».
derive: How to test derive with these vectors: for each event k+1 of a case, derive(state after event k, at_(k+1), day_(k+1), exam_day) must agree with the step the database gave event k+1 when that event is a clean right answer (not retry, not misclick, not late, peekDay != day): status started with from <= at → two_days, from > at → too_early; status due → check; two_days → early; new or learning → start.

cases.name: 23:00, then 15:00 the next day: too early until 19:00 (20 hours); 19:00 meets the rule
one local day never counts, even 23 hours apart; the next day after 20 hours does
the exam-eve rule: one day before the date a check is due 4 days after the last naming (not 5)
the same moments with the date 6 days away: no eve rule, the 5-day wait is not over
on the date itself (0 days left) the eve rule still applies; two days before too
«Нажали не туда?»: a peek — counters and the series stay, peek day = today, a right answer that day is training
a misclick on the first sight: seen today (no counted answer), a right answer that day is training
«Не знаю» pressed by mistake and marked «Нажали не туда?»: a peek like any misclick; a misclick flag under a right answer is ignored
a retry is not counted in seen; right in a retry is training, wrong in a retry is a miss
a retry flag on an item never answered under this rev is an ordinary answer
after a miss the key was seen: a right answer the same day is training; the next day starts the series
a check one second before its moment is early (the same wait starts again); at the moment it is a check; 5, 12, 25, then 50 days, and 50 again after the third
an answer for an older local day after a newer one (another device): late, the state does not move
the author changed the key (rev 2): the state starts from zero
a miss takes a counted item out of the figure (wasTwoDays), checks back to 0, named_at cleared
several correct options: all or nothing, in any order; nothing chosen = «Не знаю»
a short answer: case, spaces, ё/е and one final dot do not matter; any accepted form counts
a single item: the key index in file order; another index is wrong
